records.text: Mosaic Stadium in Regina opened in 2017; home of the Saskatchewan Roughriders; it hosted 2022 Grey Cup.
records.textJa: Mosaic Stadiumが2017年に開場した（Regina）。Saskatchewan Roughridersの本拠地。2022 Grey Cupを開催。
